title: Cleaner but Volatile Energy? The Effect of Coal Plant Retirement on Market Competition in the Wholesale Electricity Market
abstract: The energy transition from coal to gas is reshaping the power sector to rely more on gas generation, which is cleaner but has more variable input costs. Using counterfactual analysis, I study the competitive effects of this transition, by considering several transition paths that differ in the types of firms involved in retiring coal plants and investing in gas plants. I show that the variable nature of the marginal cost of gas generation creates an environment in which market power could increase after the transition. However, the transition's impact on competition depends on the characteristics of the firms investing in new gas generation; the adverse impact is mitigated under a well‐planned transition that leads to a more competitive industry structure.
abstract_zh: 电力部门从煤炭向天然气的能源转型，使发电越来越依赖天然气，天然气发电更清洁，但其可变投入成本也更加多变。本文运用反事实分析，考察了这一转型的竞争效应，并考虑了若干种转型路径，这些路径在退役煤电厂和投资天然气电厂的企业类型上有所不同。我证明，天然气发电边际成本的可变性，可能会在转型后形成市场势力上升的环境。然而，转型对竞争的影响取决于投资新建天然气发电企业的特征；在一个规划良好、能带来更具竞争性产业结构的转型路径下，这种负面影响会有所减轻。

title: Self-sustained carbon capture and utilization: Techno-economic insights for CO2 to C2H4 deployment at scale
abstract: Ethylene (C 2 H 4 ), a crucial building block in the petrochemical industry, is traditionally produced through energy-intensive thermal cracking of hydrocarbons, emitting about 1.5–3 tons of CO 2 per ton of C 2 H 4 . The proposed tandem electrochemical architecture represents a transformative approach that utilizes external electricity and water to capture and convert CO 2 in industrial flue gas into C 2 H 4 . The self-sustained system integrates three electrochemical reactors: a hybrid electrolyte reactor for capturing CO 2 while generating electricity, an auxiliary reactor for producing fuels for the capture reactor, and a conversion reactor for transforming CO 2 into C 2 H 4 . A comprehensive techno-economic assessment (TEA) reveals that the system can achieve production costs that are competitive with current market prices while significantly reducing CO 2 emissions. The TEA further demonstrates the system’s scalability and its potential to drive industrial decarbonization and sustainable CO 2 utilization. Tandem electrochemical systems represent an innovative solution to produce chemicals through sustainable means while also ensuring the possibility of eventual carbon neutrality.
abstract_zh: 乙烯（C₂H₄）是石化工业中的关键基础原料，传统上通过能源密集的热裂解碳氢化合物生产，每吨C₂H₄排放约1.5至3吨CO₂。所提出的串联电化学体系代表了一种变革性的方法，它利用外部电力和水，将工业烟道气中的CO₂捕获并转化为C₂H₄。该自持系统集成了三个电化学反应器：一个在发电的同时捕获CO₂的混合电解质反应器、一个为捕获反应器生产燃料的辅助反应器，以及一个将CO₂转化为C₂H₄的转化反应器。全面的技术经济评估（TEA）表明，该系统的生产成本可以与当前市场价格相竞争，同时显著减少CO₂排放。技术经济评估进一步证明了该系统的可扩展性，及其推动工业脱碳和可持续CO₂利用的潜力。串联电化学系统代表了一种创新方案，既能以可持续的方式生产化学品，也能确保最终实现碳中和的可能性。

title: Renewable Portfolio Standards, Vertical Structure, and Investment
abstract: Policy effectiveness within industries depends on market structures. We provide evidence of this by examining how vertical structure influences renewable capacity investments under Renewable Portfolio Standards (RPS). RPS link the upstream and downstream electricity sectors by mandating downstream firms to procure a fraction of sales from renewables. Considering various channels through which downstream firms can source investment to comply, we show that RPS-driven investments vary across states with different degrees of vertical integration in their electricity sector. We find lower investments in more vertically separated states, suggesting that the policy provides different incentives depending on the underlying market structure.
abstract_zh: 行业内的政策有效性取决于市场结构。我们通过考察纵向结构如何影响可再生能源配额制（RPS）下的可再生能源装机投资，为此提供了证据。RPS通过强制下游企业采购一定比例的可再生能源销售，将上游与下游电力部门联系起来。考虑到下游企业可用于满足合规要求的多种投资资金来源渠道，我们表明，RPS驱动的投资在电力部门纵向一体化程度不同的州之间存在差异。我们发现，纵向分离程度较高的州投资较少，这表明该政策根据基础市场结构的不同，提供了不同的激励。

title: Across the Grid: How Generation Entry Shapes Congestion and Locational Price Dispersion
abstract: This paper studies how generation entry reshapes the spatial distribution of congestion prices across the transmission network. When generation enters a network, new electricity flows can create location-specific congestion prices, generating spatially uneven price impacts across locations. We propose a differences-indifferences design that addresses identification challenges arising from network-wide spillovers and apply this framework to high-frequency nodal data from the PJM electricity market. We find that the distributional consequences of generation entry vary by generator type: wind entry increases congestion prices mainly in areas where fossil-fuel plants operate, while natural gas plant entry has no significant impact. These contrasting results indicate that generator characteristics, such as dispatchability, along with network structure are critical determinants of the spatial distribution of consumer costs and generator rents following capacity additions.
abstract_zh: 本文研究发电企业进入如何重塑输电网络中拥塞价格的空间分布。当发电进入网络时，新的电力流会产生具有地点特异性的拥塞价格，从而形成空间上不均匀的价格影响。我们提出了一种双重差分设计，以应对网络范围溢出效应带来的识别难题，并将该框架应用于PJM电力市场的高频节点数据。我们发现，发电进入的分配后果因发电机类型而异：风电进入主要增加了有化石燃料电厂运行地区的拥塞价格，而天然气电厂的进入则没有显著影响。这些截然相反的结果表明，发电机的特征（如可调度性）与网络结构一道，是容量增加之后消费者成本和发电商租金空间分布的关键决定因素。

title: Strategic Uncertainty, Competition, and Asymmetric Pass-Through: Evidence from Electricity Markets
Heterogeneous Impacts of Cost Shocks, Strategic Bidding, and Pass-Through: Evidence from the New England Electricity Market
abstract: Industry-wide shocks can have heterogeneous impacts on firms’ costs due to different firm characteristics. The heterogeneity of these impacts is crucial for understanding the pass-through of the shock because of its implications for strategic competition. In the context of the gas price shock in the electricity market, I develop a method to identify the heterogeneous impacts of the shock and show, with a structural analysis, that the heterogeneous feature of the shock induces markup adjustments in firms. Pass-through that is estimated without incorporating the existing heterogeneous impacts fails to reflect the change in competition arising from the shock and is, on average, underestimated. (JEL D24, L11, L94. L95, L98, Q35)
abstract_zh: 行业范围的冲击会因企业特征的不同而对其成本产生异质性影响。这种影响的异质性对于理解冲击的传导至关重要，因为它关系到战略竞争的含义。在电力市场天然气价格冲击的背景下，我提出了一种识别该冲击异质性影响的方法，并通过结构分析表明，冲击的异质性特征会诱发企业加成率（markup）的调整。若在估计传导时未纳入既存的异质性影响，则所估计的传导将无法反映冲击所引发的竞争变化，平均而言会被低估。（JEL D24, L11, L94, L95, L98, Q35）
